'''''Heroc's Slayer''''' was a modified [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] used by a group of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. They used it in pursuit of a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]], who was in over one hundred thousand [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] in debt to the loan shark who had hired the hunters, on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agricultural]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Fether]]. They would later hunt [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] agents to the planet, [[Issagra]].
